preprocessing.band_integration: trapezoid on low <= frequency < high, including the 1-40 Hz total-power denominator
preprocessing.filter: scipy.signal.butter SOS + sosfiltfilt, per recording, offline

quality_control.flat_epoch: exclude if any raw channel has exact zero peak-to-peak before filtering
quality_control.nonfinite_recording: exclude all candidate windows; fail preparation if any participant loses either class

qc.flat_rule: Any raw epoch channel has exactly zero peak-to-peak voltage
qc.nonfinite_rule: Reject complete recording; no interpolation or imputation

source_transport.cache_policy: Preexisting cache origin is not inferred; every EDF must match canonical publisher SHA256, including files from official mirrors.

task: baseline eyes-open versus eyes-closed; not drowsiness or diagnosis
